nodes.title: Grounding exchange (ported interview)
nodes.body:
Q: Sketch parallel-utils in one breath: what is it, what shape gives it value, and how is it built?

A: A zero-dependency TS utility library of 8 independent leaves fanning out from one scaffold prerequisite, built so a parallel cook run fires them concurrently.

nodes.title: Design answer (ported interview)
nodes.body: Keep every utility file-disjoint with a single export so the leaves stay independent and fan out from one scaffold.
